statements.impact_statement: The vulnerable code is optional contrib/infback9/inftree9.c, not the standard libz implementation. The Alpine zlib 1.3.2-r1 runtime shared library does not compile this optional Deflate64 code. Immutable v1.8.0-rc.14 images were inspected on linux/amd64 and linux/arm64: all layer hashes verified, no infback9/inftree9 paths or GDAL library, no inflateBack9/inflate_table9 symbols in libz, with ordinary zlib symbols present as controls. No other APK revision or vulnerability is covered. Artifact digests and evidence: https://github.com/CodesWhat/drydock/pull/1544#issuecomment-6713748413. Upstream scope: https://github.com/madler/zlib/pull/1235.
